shared.mac_missing: the server did not sign the reply

cli.closed_without_bye: the control connection closed without a bye
cli.no_reply_timeout: no reply within the socket timeout
cli.mac_verify_failed: the reply mac does not verify — the wire was tampered with
cli.command_too_long: the typed command exceeds the control wire's line cap (%d bytes) — shorten it
cli.reply_too_long: the reply exceeds the control wire's line cap (%d bytes)
cli.keepalive_invalid: invalid CLI_KEEPALIVE %r: must be a number of seconds (0 = off)

ctl.mac_verify_failed: the reply mac does not verify (tampered or corrupted frame)
ctl.command_too_long: the command exceeds the control wire's line cap (%d bytes) — shorten it
ctl.reply_too_long: the reply exceeds the control wire's line cap (%d bytes) — the connection is gone

banner.hint: %   TAB completes, ? lists the commands, quit leaves

wire.set_needs_value: set needs a setting and a value (try help)
wire.dump_interval_needs_path: dump-interval needs a dump path (set dump-path or --dump-path)
wire.secret_not_value: *** SECRET REMOVED *** is not a value — pass the secret by flag/env, or as file:<path>
wire.secret_never_shows: %s is a secret — it never shows (pass it by flag/env, or as file:<path>)
wire.restore_on_start_invalid: restore-on-start must be on or off
wire.ops_policy_invalid: the ops policy needs at least one verb the grammar speaks%s: %s
wire.acl_table_value: "table" is not a %s value — the table is the show: show %s
wire.suite_auth_needs_key: the suite auth needs a key: pass auth-key by flag/env/config (min %d characters) and restart
wire.unsigned_command: unsigned command rejected: TCP commands carry the hmac-sha256 of the command, keyed by the token
wire.command_mac_failed: the command mac does not verify (tampered or corrupted frame)
wire.forbidden: forbidden: the ops token runs the %s verbs only (%s needs the admin token)
wire.knobs_header: ok knobs — the registry of %s: every knob, its flag, its env twin, how it changes
wire.show_config_comment: generated by show config — the secret knobs render as *** SECRET REMOVED ***, pass them by flag/env, or as file:<path>
wire.f5_tokenless: control-port cannot serve TCP without a token (F5 in docs/SECURITY.md): pass the token by flag/env/config and restart
wire.reload_needs_config: err reload needs a config path (start with --config)
wire.reload_ok: ok reload: %s, the daemon restarts now
wire.reload_lost_secret: (%s: secret, not saved — re-pass by flag/env, or as file:<path>)
wire.no_dump_path: err no dump path configured (set dump-path or --dump-path)
wire.no_dump_yet: err no dump at %s yet (run dump first)

daemon.control_cannot_bind: control server cannot bind %s: %s (use --control-port 0 to disable it)
